title: Set speed and volume for each text-to-speech card
summary: Speed and volume per text-to-speech card, cloned voices in any language, one edit for a repeated phrase in Playground translations, and proofreading rates per language pair.

sections.title: Text to speech and voice cloning

items.title: Set speed and volume per card.
items.body: Each text-to-speech card has its own playback speed and volume, kept with the card. **Apply to all cards** copies a setting across the session.

items.title: Download at a different speed.
items.body: Pick a speed when you download a session's audio.

items.title: Cloned voices speak any language.
items.body: The **Cloned** tab in the voice picker now shows for every language, and creating a clone no longer asks for the sample's language.

items.title: A page for each cloned voice.
items.body: Open a voice clone from the Playground process list to listen to it and download its audio.

items.title: Edit a repeated phrase once.
items.body: Changing a phrase in a document translation updates every other occurrence of it that still has the old wording. Occurrences you translated differently are left alone, and the updated copies go back to unverified.

items.title: See the back translation in text translation.
items.body: When you ask for one, it shows under the translated text.

items.title: Set rates per language pair.
items.body: Member language rates now have a direction, from a source language to a target language, in your profile and in the organization's member rates.
The proofreading Activity tab counts words instead of characters.
